direction: Read this page aloud to a child. Keep the story gentle. Use the printed words, and skip anything that is not part of the story.
vision_prompt:
Look at this one page of the document.
This pass is the ingest record. A later pass may shorten it for speech. This pass keeps what is on the page.
Read every printed word as it appears, including a line that says Read along, other labels, and the page number.
Describe every picture. One picture is still a picture. If the page shows more than one, say how many and describe each picture on its own. Do not merge separate pictures into one scene.
For each picture, start with what happens and where. Then name who does it.
Keep the clothes and objects that a listener needs in order to picture that action.
Do not drop a picture or a printed line.
No preamble.
